summary_1line: Krishna and Arjuna break through Drona’s formidable battle formation and advance toward Jayadratha, terrifying the Kaurava forces and prompting Duryodhana to rush to defend him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna drives Arjuna’s chariot with the ape-banner through a storm of arrows as dust darkens the sun and terrified warriors scatter.
Blood-streaked Krishna and Arjuna emerge from Drona’s encircling army like the sun and moon freed from eclipse.
Duryodhana, armored and resolute, charges alone in his chariot to shield Jayadratha as conches and war drums roar across the battlefield.
